discription: A simple pulse wave synth with a detuned second oscillator and a low-pass filter, controlled by an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, detune=1.005, cutoff=8000, rq=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth); sig = sig + Pulse.ar(freq * detune, pulseWidth); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
